_sources.gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (fetched 2026-10-15; Standard tier): per-image prices by size, and per-1M-token rates for input, text and thinking output, and image output
_sources.gemini_input_images: Gemini 3 models: 1120 tokens per image at the default media resolution (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/media-resolution); gemini-2.5-flash-image: 258 tokens per 768 px tile (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/tokens), at most 88 tiles within imgen's input caps
_sources.gemini_size: With no size, Gemini makes 1K, or matches the output to the input image (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation)
_sources.openai: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (fetched 2026-10-15; Standard tier, per 1M tokens; Images API calls pay the non-cached rates)
_sources.openai_output_tokens: gpt-image-2 and gpt-image-2.5: quality factors of the token calculator in https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation, which reproduces the guide's nine GPT Image 2 per-image prices; gpt-image-1 and gpt-image-1.5: the guide's token table for 1024x1024, 1024x1536 and 1536x1024
_sources.openai_max_size: 2880x2880 gives the most output tokens of every size the guide allows (multiples of 16, edges up to 3840, 655,360 to 8,294,400 pixels, ratio up to 3:1); TestFormulaMaxSize checks it
_sources.openai_input_images: OpenAI publishes an input rule for gpt-image-1 only, and points GPT Image 2 to it: at high fidelity at most 6240 + 65 + 4 x 129 = 6821 tokens per image
_sources.openai_mini: gpt-image-1-mini: the guide's per-image prices are above its token table at $8/M, so the per-image prices are its bound
_sources.openai_partial_images: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation: each streamed partial image costs an additional 100 image output tokens
_sources.text_out_tokens: Room held for the text and thinking (Gemini) or reasoning (gpt-image-1.5) that a model writes with one image; after the call the reported tokens count
_sources.codex: Codex runs on plan quota; no per-call charge
